sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Everfight was one of the first spells that Lok Lambert managed to use successfully. After watching Dante Vale use it to recover after being hit by a Poisonheat spell, he did the same to recover from being hit by an Augerfrost, allowing him to turn the tide against DeFoe and his Suits, and give Dante Vale time to bond with Metagolem. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

During his battle with Wilder on Avalon, Lok was so badly hurt that he did not have enough strength to use Everfight. [Knight of the Willblade]

Sophie Casterwill used this spell in the lab of Klaus' bookshop after being hit by a Nullcurse from the Silent Soldiers. [The Blood Spiral]

Dante used the spell outside the Pyramid of the Sun whilst holding off a group of Casterwill Hunters. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Sophie later used the spell in the Vault of Cortes after being hit by an Augerfrost from Hoffman. [The Power of Umbra]

Whilst recovering amidst the final battle against The Betrayer, Zhalia Moon used this spell to take some weight off Den Fears who was helping her. Lok then used the spell twice, desperate to recover so that he could fight again. [Dante's Return]

full_text:
Everfight is a spell which allows the caster to partially heal themselves. The spell manifests itself as an amber aura surrounding the Seeker.

== History ==
Everfight was one of the first spells that Lok Lambert managed to use successfully. After watching Dante Vale use it to recover after being hit by a Poisonheat spell, he did the same to recover from being hit by an Augerfrost, allowing him to turn the tide against DeFoe and his Suits, and give Dante Vale time to bond with Metagolem. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies]

During his battle with Wilder on Avalon, Lok was so badly hurt that he did not have enough strength to use Everfight. [Knight of the Willblade]

Sophie Casterwill used this spell in the lab of Klaus' bookshop after being hit by a Nullcurse from the Silent Soldiers. [The Blood Spiral]

Dante used the spell outside the Pyramid of the Sun whilst holding off a group of Casterwill Hunters. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Sophie later used the spell in the Vault of Cortes after being hit by an Augerfrost from Hoffman. [The Power of Umbra]

Whilst recovering amidst the final battle against The Betrayer, Zhalia Moon used this spell to take some weight off Den Fears who was helping her. Lok then used the spell twice, desperate to recover so that he could fight again. [Dante's Return]
